items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I remember the time when I was coming along and first started playing trumpet, they had a cat out there they called 'High-C Foster.'

ctx.x: But you can still play higher ones.

Some can and some can't. See, I remember the time when I was coming along and first started playing trumpet, they had a cat out there they called "High-C Foster." He played High-C and they thought that was great. That's what they called him, because he played... He didn't play no Jazz.
Where was he from? Where did he play?
